recipes.name: Vegan 'Egg' Salad Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C)*. Add the potatoes to a lined baking tray and drizzle over the oil. Toss to coat.
Then sprinkle over the onion powder, paprika, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Toss again, then bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven, stir, and now add the vine of tomatoes to the tray to bake with the potatoes. Return to the oven for another 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden.

Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high. Crumble in the tofu with your hands. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring throughout. The aim is to get the tofu soft and spongy, but not too crispy.
Then add in the salt, turmeric, and pepper. Cook for an additional 1 to 2 minutes while stirring so that the spices toast.
Remove from the heat, and transfer the tofu to a bowl. Add in the mayo and curry powder, and stir well.

Thinly slice the entire stalk of green onion. The white bottom part of the onion can be further minced and then stirred into the "egg" salad mixture. The sliced green part of the onion can be reserved for garnish.
For the garlic spinach, heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high. When hot, add the garlic and cook until golden, about 4 to 5 minutes.
Then add all the spinach, soy sauce, and sambal. Cook for another minute, or until the spinach is wilted.
Serve each component of the meal in bowls, alongside some avocado. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Best if enjoyed immediately. The potatoes, egg salad, and garlic spinach can be stored separately in airtight container s in the fridge for up to 3 days.
